value.answer: I'm sorry you're looking for one right now. If things get urgent, go to the nearest emergency room or call your local emergency number straight away. The free option is the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program, which covers depression and anxiety. You can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp without a health card, and an intake clinician will check whether it's a good fit. If you can pay, the Centre for Training in Psychotherapy in Toronto charges about $45 a session with a supervised student therapist, though that figure is from an older list and may have changed. I couldn't confirm that any of these are taking new clients right now.
